verdicts.reason: query 问的是 § 312.32(c)(1)(i) 所举的示例情形，答案是引导句加三个项目符号，但 evidence_span 从“Suspected adverse reaction means — any adverse event for which there is a reasonable possibility that the drug caused the adverse event.”起始，纳入了整段定义以及与本问无关的一句“Therefore, if no drug has been administered, an adverse event is not reportable under IND safety reporting regulations.”，属于把整节前置内容一并塞入，不符合“long_context 的 span 应是一段连贯的完整列表或要件清单”的要求。按 char_start=38 起算前置段落约 750 字符，去掉后从“The following examples are also provided…”到“…standard of care for the disease or condition.”约 1,100 字符，低于 1,500 字符阈值，说明现有 span 的超长很可能来自为触发 long_context 而扩大范围。
verdicts.suggestion: 将 evidence_span 收紧为“The following examples are also provided in the IND safety reporting regulation (§ 312.32(c)(1)(i)) and illustrate the meaning of reasonable possibility …”至“…standard of care for the disease or condition.”（含三个项目符号，key_text 仍包含其中），并相应去掉 long_context 切片；若本集需要 long_context 覆盖，另选 span 本身即超过 1,500 字符的完整清单类条款。

verdicts.reason: key_text 起自句中："within 12-24 months to allow the possibility of necessary changes in healthcare; and • Within 4 years of regulatory implementation the overall effectiveness evaluation of the RMM"。页文本原句为 "• After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g. within 12-24 months to allow the possibility of necessary changes in healthcare;"，key_text 切掉了第一个时间点的对象 "an initial evaluation of RMM"，单看命中只剩孤立时限，无法判断 12-24 个月内应做何事，违反 P1「同时保留对象与约束的命中含义」；第二个时间点则保留了对象，前后不一致。evidence_span、切片与部门归属无问题。
verdicts.suggestion: key_text 前移至包含第一个时间点的对象，例如 "After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g. within 12-24 months to allow the possibility of necessary changes in healthcare; and • Within 4 years of regulatory implementation the overall effectiveness evaluation of the RMM"（该串在页内仍恰好出现一次）。

verdicts.reason: evidence_span 两端均截断于句中，不是完整条款：开头 “age information is reported, and this information should be available…” 截自原句 “Useful data retrieval and analysis can only be performed if age information is reported”；结尾 “If no age-related information is provided” 为悬空片段，原文续为 “by the initial reporter, the marketing authorisation holder or the competent authority should request, as appropriate, follow-up information on age.”。偏移长度（539–1199，660 字符）与所给 text 一致，但边界切分不当。
verdicts.suggestion: 将 span 收敛为完整条款：“As far as possible, the ICSRs should indicate either: • the age at time of onset of reaction or the date of birth, and for neonates, pre-term neonates and infants in addition the gestational age; or • affiliation to one of the paediatric age subsets if it is not possible to obtain the exact age or date of birth or if personal data protection legislation do not permit this in order to prevent identifying the patient, in particular when the medical condition is rare.” 并同步修正 char_start/char_end。

verdicts.reason: evidence_span 起止均落在句中，不构成完整条款：开头 “periodic safety update reports (PSUR) as described in GVP Module VII should be followed.” 截掉了原句主语 “The requirements for”；结尾 “via the PSURs, as they” 为悬空片段，原文续为 “are an important tool to collect and cumulatively analyse information on paediatric use.”。偏移（513–865，352 字符）与 text 自身一致，但句界切分错误。
verdicts.suggestion: 将 span 调整为 “The requirements for periodic safety update reports (PSUR) as described in GVP Module VII should be followed. When a paediatric indication has been granted, ongoing monitoring of the risk-benefit balance specifically for this indication throughout the product life-cycle should be performed (unless exempted from PSUR submission with a justification) via the PSURs, as they are an important tool to collect and cumulatively analyse information on paediatric use.” 并同步修正偏移。
